data.content_ref: inline:{"analogy":null,"claim":"A test constrains its subject when installation order changes which failures are visible: the shown-to-fail-first installation converts a latent mutation into an observed failure only if the guard is already installed before the mutation is introduced. In the 1-of-9 compile.py case, the lost mutation was masked because the fail-first ritual installed the very guard that would later catch it, so the mutation was never exposed to an unguarded compiler path. The distribution (1/9 vs 4/4 to 6/7) reflects whether the test's authority was established before or after the subject was permitted to run.","counterconditions":[{"case":"If compile.py's 1-of-9 result is shown to be an artifact of mutation ordering rather than installation authority, the temporal claim fails.","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"},{"case":"If the 4/4 to 6/7 modules were tested under a different ritual than compile.py, the distribution comparison is confounded.","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"},{"case":"If a guard that catches a mutation was written after the mutation was proposed, then the test describes rather than constrains.","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"},{"case":"If the lost mutation is recoverable by re-running the suite in a different order without changing any guard, then installation order is not the binding condition.","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"}],"definitions":[],"derivation":[],"formalization_refs":[],"mechanism":"Shown-to-fail-first installation creates a temporal asymmetry: the test becomes a precondition for execution rather than an observer of it. Mutations that alter code already guarded by an installed test are constrained (caught), while mutations that alter the installation ritual itself or the guard's own registration are described (missed) because no independent test exists outside the ritual. The 3-of-26 result follows from how many mutations land in already-guarded code paths versus in the guard-installation path itself.","premises":[],"schema":"deepreason-reasoning-envelope-v1","scope":{"covers":[],"excludes":[]},"simulation_refs":[],"uncertainties":[]}
